text: Loved... or feared? Which makes you stronger?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Machiavelli asked this over five hundred years ago.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Picture a new team leader who never says no. She just wants to be liked.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: His answer? Ideally, both. But if you must choose... it is much safer to be feared than loved, when, of the two, either must be dispensed with.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: But here's the catch. He also says: avoid hatred.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: A wise prince should establish himself on that which is in his own control, and not in that of others.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He meant fear. My take? Love depends on others. Respect, you can earn, with clear, fair standards.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Your action today: set one clear standard... and keep it, calmly.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Loved or respected... which would you choose? Comment below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz for your daily mindset.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
